text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Damn. My lap times are getting worse. I
might've
consumed some unnecessary
calories.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Wow, I have to say I'm surprised that
even you
can't resist the allure of tasty
treats.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Why? It's only natural that I find
glutamate and
inosinate as delicious as
the next person.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Consuming glucose causes insulin to be
released,
increasing serotonin
production.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I see. Essentially, you have the same
desires as
ordinary people on some
level.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, I have the perfect medicine to
take off the
extra weight. Simply take
one tablet a day and—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I don't think so. All I need to do is
steer
clear of high-calorie food. Now,
cut it out with
that stuff. You're gettin'
on my nerves.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Air Shakur manages to get
back to her
previous weight through
careful management of
her food intake.
